detail.longDescription: Writing manual JSON schema wrappers for every market endpoint gets messy fast. Connecting an agent runtime to a dedicated market data MCP server exposes 33 pre-built tools over SSE, returning candle schemas like SymbolCode, Bid, Ask, and Volume directly. You skip maintaining custom tool definitions for XAUUSD or EURUSD. Are you running agents with remote MCP servers or keeping REST tools local? # ModelContextProtocol # MachineLearning
